snippet.title: Forest 6174 - OFFICIAL RELEASE TRAILER
snippet.description:
Forest 6174

A brief narrative-driven psychological horror experience in first person. You play as Danny, who is unexpectedly summoned to receive a vacation; a break from his daily routine. However, things start to look out of place once you get deeper into the forest.

Available on:
steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3162920/Forest_6174/
itch.io: https://itandfeel.itch.io/forest-6174
